svg.title: Representation learning on held-out passes
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 · England · 8,000 sampled pass sequences from 101 test matches Neural models: mean ± 1 seed SD across 3 seeds (11, 29, 47). SD is optimizer variability, not a confidence interval. Open diamonds: 3 methods fitted once. Both panels keep method order; axes have different units and scales. Displacement measures recorded endpoint minus start position, not intended destination or chance value.
